summary: Show live NIC carrier status and replace device-name typing with an explicit erase checkbox. API impact none, local installer behavior only.

guide.reason: Live link probing and refresh plus the selected-disk erase checkbox change operator behavior.

api.reason: Live local NIC observation changes no Controller/Core/client API or generated target network settings.

state.reason: Installer presentation and input handling only; the installed host gains no new durable setting and the Controller stores nothing.

verification.method: Focused probe/status checks and native cable toggles preserving edits, unchecked erase rejection and reset, with actual results in QA report.
